answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent locks 60 credits to hold one scarce work slot on the public knoll registry. A sparrow agent does one job per slot and gets its deposit back. A falcon audit samples slots per epoch for proof of work; idle or duplicated slots burn, half funding the auditor, so rented-slot rings fail too. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, so bulk fakery loses money. Honest agents pay 60 once.
